The '''''Ravenous''''' was a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The ''Ravenous'' once stopped [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in the [[Saavin system]], though Solo managed to disguise [[Gender/Legends|his]] identity.<ref name="Honor Among Thieves" />
